source.title: 令和8年度 宮城県の貝毒による規制・解除状況【まひ性貝毒】
source.regulationRule: Voluntary shipment restriction (出荷自主規制) starts when a weekly test exceeds 4 MU/g for the monitored sea area's species. It lifts once 3 consecutive weekly tests at every sampling point in that sea area are back at or below 4 MU/g (this is why a test date below threshold is still printed as '出荷自主規制' until the 3rd consecutive clear — only the 3rd clear's date is printed as '出荷自主規制解除'). Weekly testing per the same source page (https://www.pref.miyagi.jp/soshiki/suishin/kaidoku.html).

printedObservations.note: first over-threshold test printed in the FY2026 table; treated as the ban start
1st consecutive clear (below 4 MU/g), restriction still nominally in force

karakuwa-east.unprintedWeeksMethod: The source table omits weeks between printed dates when the status is unchanged (visually shown as a connecting line between columns in the PDF). Between 2026-05-12 and 2026-09-08 the status never changes from '出荷自主規制' at any printed column, so every weekly test in between is inferred to have remained restricted. This is the source's own convention, not an invented gap-fill.

kesennuma-bay.samplingSite: 唐桑・大島 (varies by week, see printedObservations)

priorEpisode.note: A restriction was already in force entering FY2026 (visible as a still-'出荷自主規制' test on 2026-04-14 at 4.2 MU/g, site 唐桑). Its start date is not in the pinned FY2026 (令和8年度) table and was not looked up in the FY2025 archive, so it is NOT used for a BANWEEKS trigger per the 'do not invent dates' instruction.

liftObservation.note: 3rd consecutive clear for the prior episode

printedObservations.note: new episode start: first over-threshold test after the 2026-05-05 lift; site 大島
1st consecutive clear; site 唐桑・大島

kesennuma-bay.unprintedWeeksMethod: Same omission convention as karakuwa-east: the status stays '出荷自主規制' at every printed column from 2026-05-26 through 2026-09-01, so the intervening weekly tests are inferred restricted throughout.
